description: Mail via Hamad International Airport by type, month and year is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset contains monthly statistics on mail processed through Hamad International Airport. It records the volume of dispatched and received mail by month and year. Each record includes both English and Arabic labels, facilitating bilingual accessibility. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are mail, dispatched, received, Hamad, airport. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-08-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and air transport studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
